name: Runeborn (Campaign; Mythic [Archmage])
body:
Warning! Mythic traits are a bit more powerful than most traits—this is intentional, as these traits help to set up a character’s mythic background! Mythic traits are intended for use with Mythic characters.

You bear a strange birthmark on your body. You’ve long felt magic in your blood, and casting spells comes easily to you.

Benefit You gain a +2 trait bonus on concentration checks.
